name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
shortDescription: The scheme aims to supplement the financial needs of all landholding farmers’ families by procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields.
description: The scheme aims to supplement the financial needs of all landholding farmers’ families by procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields. Under the scheme an amount of ₹ 6000/- per year is released by the Central Government online directly into the bank accounts.
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs. 6000 per year in 3 equal installments.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Documents (Khasra/Khatauni), Bank Account Details.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
shortDescription: PMFBY aims to provide financial protection to farmers against crop loss due to natural disasters (hail, drought, floods), pests, and diseases.
description: PMFBY aims to provide financial protection to farmers against crop loss due to natural disasters (hail, drought, floods), pests, and diseases. It offers crop insurance at a very low premium to farmers.
amount: Based on Crop Loss / Sum Insured
benefits: Insurance cover against crop loss. Premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops.
eligibility: Farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC), Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Sowing Certificate.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
shortDescription: The KCC Scheme provides adequate and timely credit to farmers for their agricultural operations. The Government provides interest subvention.
description: The KCC Scheme provides adequate and timely credit to farmers for their agricultural operations. The Government provides interest subvention, making credit available at a subsidized rate of 4% per annum.
amount: Credit limit based on land & crop scale
benefits: Short term credit for crops, post-harvest expenses, and consumption requirements.
eligibility: All farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and SHGs of farmers.
documents: Application Form, Identity Proof, Address Proof, Land Records.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
shortDescription: The scheme focuses on enhancing water use efficiency at the farm level through Micro Irrigation (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation System).
description: The scheme focuses on enhancing water use efficiency at the farm level through Micro Irrigation (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation System). It supports micro-level water storage and conservation.
amount: Subsidy varies by state (approx 55% for small farmers)
benefits: Subsidy for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Farmers with cultivable land and water source.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Bank Details, Water Source Proof.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
shortDescription: PKVY aims at supporting and promoting organic farming to improve soil health. It promotes the Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) for India.
description: PKVY aims at supporting and promoting organic farming to improve soil health. It promotes the Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) for India form of organic certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 per hectare for 3 years.
eligibility: Farmers practicing organic farming in clusters.
documents: Registration with Regional Council, Land Documents, Aadhaar.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure (AMI)
shortDescription: This scheme supports the creation of scientific storage capacity (godowns) and other marketing infrastructure to help farmers sell their produce at better prices.
description: This scheme supports the creation of scientific storage capacity (godowns) and other marketing infrastructure to help farmers sell their produce at better prices.
amount: Subsidy up to ₹ 4 Crores (depending on project)
benefits: Capital subsidy of 25% (33.33% for SC/ST/North East) on project cost.
eligibility: Farmers, Partnerships, NGOs, SHGs, Cooperatives.
documents: Project Report, Land Documents, Bank Loan Sanction Letter.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Rainfed Area Development (RAD)
shortDescription: Focuses on Integrated Farming System (IFS) for enhancing productivity and minimizing risks associated with climatic variability in rainfed areas.
description: Focuses on Integrated Farming System (IFS) for enhancing productivity and minimizing risks associated with climatic variability in rainfed areas.
benefits: Support for Horticulture, Livestock, Fishery, Agro-Forestry along with crops.
eligibility: Farmers in rainfed areas.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Land Documents, Bank Details.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Integrated Farming in Micro Watershed
shortDescription: Launched by the Govt of Meghalaya to promote integrated farming activities for improved livelihood in a complementary manner.
description: Launched by the Govt of Meghalaya to promote integrated farming activities for improved livelihood in a complementary manner.
benefits: Support for sustainable farming models in watershed areas.
eligibility: Farmers residing in identified micro-watershed areas.
documents: Residential Certificate, Land Documents, Bank Passbook.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (State)

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
shortDescription: A Maharashtra state scheme where farmers eligible for PM-Kisan receive an additional financial benefit.
description: A Maharashtra state scheme where farmers eligible for PM-Kisan receive an additional financial benefit.
benefits: Additional ₹ 6000/- per year in three installments.
eligibility: Farmers of Maharashtra who are eligible for PM-Kisan.
documents: Same as PM-Kisan (Aadhaar linked to Bank Account).
ministry: Government of Maharashtra

name: Training to Farmers (Tamil Nadu)
shortDescription: Offers training to maize-growing farmers in 18 selected districts of Tamil Nadu to adopt better practices.
description: Offers training to maize-growing farmers in 18 selected districts of Tamil Nadu to adopt better practices.
benefits: Training costs covered + Financial assistance of ₹300/- per farmer.
eligibility: Maize growing farmers in selected districts of Tamil Nadu.
documents: Community Certificate, Aadhaar, Bank Passbook.
ministry: Agriculture-Farmers Welfare Department, TN

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
shortDescription: MIDH covers horticulture items such as fruits, vegetables, root & tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, aromatic plants, coconut, cashew, cocoa and bamboo.
description: MIDH covers horticulture items such as fruits, vegetables, root & tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, aromatic plants, coconut, cashew, cocoa and bamboo.
benefits: Technical advice and administrative support for horticulture farms.
eligibility: Farmers, SHGs, FPOs engaged in Horticulture.
documents: Land Documents, Project Proposal, Aadhaar.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
shortDescription: Promotes the usage of farm mechanization to increase productivity. It helps farmers purchase tractors and other farm machinery.
description: Promotes the usage of farm mechanization to increase productivity. It helps farmers purchase tractors and other farm machinery.
benefits: Subsidy (40% to 60%) on purchase of agricultural machinery.
eligibility: All Farmers (SC/ST/Women get higher subsidy).
documents: Aadhaar, Land Record, Quotation of Machinery, Bank Passbook.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
shortDescription: Aims to bring about ecologically healthy, economically viable, and socially inclusive development of the fisheries sector.
description: Aims to bring about ecologically healthy, economically viable, and socially inclusive development of the fisheries sector.
benefits: Financial assistance for boats, nets, ponds, and fish feed.
eligibility: Fishers, Fish Farmers, Fish Workers, SHGs.
documents: Fisherman Card, Aadhaar, Project Report.
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

name: PM-KUSUM Scheme (Solar Pumps)
shortDescription: Subsidizes farmers to install solar irrigation pumps for cultivation to reduce dependency on diesel and grid electricity.
description: Subsidizes farmers to install solar irrigation pumps for cultivation to reduce dependency on diesel and grid electricity.
benefits: 60% subsidy to set up solar tube wells and pump sets.
eligibility: Individual Farmers, Water User Associations.
documents: Land Documents, Aadhaar, Bank Details.
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

name: Interest Subvention Scheme (ISS)
shortDescription: Provides short-term credit to farmers at subsidized interest rates. It ensures farmers get loans at 7% p.a., with an additional 3% subvention for timely repayment.
description: Provides short-term credit to farmers at subsidized interest rates. It ensures farmers get loans at 7% p.a., with an additional 3% subvention for timely repayment.
benefits: Loans at 4% effective interest rate (after prompt repayment).
eligibility: Farmers availing short-term crop loans up to ₹3 Lakhs.
documents: Kisan Credit Card (KCC), Land Records, Bank Account.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

name: GOBARdhan Scheme
shortDescription: Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan) aims to convert cattle dung and solid waste into compost, biogas, and bio-CNG.
description: Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan (GOBARdhan) aims to convert cattle dung and solid waste into compost, biogas, and bio-CNG.
benefits: Financial support for setting up Biogas/Bio-CNG plants.
eligibility: Gram Panchayats, SHGs, Cooperatives.
documents: Project Proposal, Land availability proof.
ministry: Ministry Of Jal Shakti

name: National Bamboo Mission
shortDescription: Focuses on the development of the complete value chain of the bamboo sector, linking growers with consumers.
description: Focuses on the development of the complete value chain of the bamboo sector, linking growers with consumers.
benefits: Subsidy for bamboo plantation and setting up processing units.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, SHGs.
documents: Land Records, Project Report, Bank Details.
ministry: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
shortDescription: A credit-linked subsidy scheme to generate employment opportunities through the establishment of micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector for rural as well as urban areas.
description: A credit-linked subsidy scheme to generate employment opportunities through the establishment of micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector for rural as well as urban areas.
amount: Project Cost up to ₹50 Lakhs (Mfg) / ₹20 Lakhs (Service)
benefits: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises. General Category: 15-25% subsidy. Special Category: 25-35% subsidy.
eligibility: Any individual above 18 years of age. Self Help Groups (SHGs), Cooperative Societies.
documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Project Report, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Rural Area Certificate.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G)
shortDescription: Aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
description: Aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca house of 25 sq. mt.
eligibility: Houseless families or families living in zero/one/two room kutcha houses (based on SECC 2011 data).
documents: Aadhaar Number, Job Card (MGNREGA), Bank Account Details, Swachh Bharat Mission number.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana (DAY-NRLM)
shortDescription: Promotes poverty reduction by building strong institutions for the poor, particularly women, and enabling them to access financial services and livelihoods.
description: Promotes poverty reduction by building strong institutions for the poor, particularly women, and enabling them to access financial services and livelihoods.
benefits: Revolving Fund (RF) and Community Investment Fund (CIF) for Self Help Groups (SHGs).
eligibility: Rural poor households, ensuring at least one woman member from each household is brought into the SHG network.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Bank Account details of the SHG.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
shortDescription: Aims to provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected habitations in rural areas to improve market access for farmers.
description: Aims to provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected habitations in rural areas to improve market access for farmers.
benefits: Construction of all-weather roads to connect rural habitations.
eligibility: Habitations with population of 500+ (Plains) or 250+ (Hilly/Tribal areas).
documents: Not Applicable (Community Infrastructure Scheme)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

name: Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY)
shortDescription: Each Member of Parliament adopts a Gram Panchayat to guide its holistic progress, turning it into a model village ('Adarsh Gram').
description: Each Member of Parliament adopts a Gram Panchayat to guide its holistic progress, turning it into a model village ('Adarsh Gram').
benefits: Holistic development including better infrastructure, digitization, and social development.
eligibility: Gram Panchayats adopted by the Member of Parliament.
documents: Not Applicable (Community Development Scheme)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
shortDescription: Aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections by 2024 to all households in rural India.
description: Aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections by 2024 to all households in rural India.
benefits: Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) for every rural home.
eligibility: All rural households.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Proof of Address.
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
shortDescription: An Accident Insurance Scheme offering accidental death and disability cover for death or disability on account of an accident.
description: An Accident Insurance Scheme offering accidental death and disability cover for death or disability on account of an accident.
benefits: Risk coverage of ₹2 Lakh for accidental death and full disability; ₹1 Lakh for partial disability.
eligibility: All individual bank account holders in the age group of 18 to 70 years.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account with Auto-Debit authorization.
ministry: Ministry of Finance

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
shortDescription: A life insurance scheme offering coverage for death due to any reason. It is a one-year cover, renewable from year to year.
description: A life insurance scheme offering coverage for death due to any reason. It is a one-year cover, renewable from year to year.
benefits: Life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh in case of death due to any reason.
eligibility: Individuals aged 18-50 years with a bank/post office account.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account details.
ministry: Ministry of Finance

name: Abua Awas Yojana (Jharkhand)
shortDescription: A state-specific housing scheme by Jharkhand Govt to provide pucca houses to homeless families, prioritizing vulnerable groups.
description: A state-specific housing scheme by Jharkhand Govt to provide pucca houses to homeless families, prioritizing vulnerable groups.
benefits: Financial assistance to build a 3-room pucca house (31 sq. meters).
eligibility: Homeless families and those living in kutcha houses in Jharkhand.
documents: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Domicile Certificate.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (Jharkhand)

name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)
shortDescription: Ensures food security for all, including internal migrants, by enabling them to access PDS benefits from any Fair Price Shop anywhere in the country.
description: Ensures food security for all, including internal migrants, by enabling them to access PDS benefits from any Fair Price Shop anywhere in the country.
benefits: Portability of ration cards; buy subsidized food grains from any ration shop in India.
eligibility: All NFSA beneficiaries (Ration Card holders).
documents: Ration Card, Aadhaar seeding with Ration Card.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

name: Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp (PoCRA)
shortDescription: The Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp was conceptualised by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra and the World Bank to develop a d...
description: The Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp was conceptualised by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra and the World Bank to develop a drought-proofing and climate-resilient strategy for the agriculture sector as a long-term and sustainable measure, to address the likely impacts of climate variabilities and climate change. The project focuses on the evidence-based scientific implementation of this plan. The project has introduced transformational changes in the agriculture sector by scaling up the adoption of climate-smart technologies and practices at the farm and micro-watershed level, contributing to drought-proofing and creation of new opportunities in villages worst hit by drought and salinity/sodicity affected villages in the state.
amount: Variable assistance based on project component (e.g., drip irrigation, farm ponds, shade nets).
benefits: Support for climate-resilient agriculture technologies, water harvesting structures, and salinity/sodicity control measures. Investments are supported for farmers and collectives to access water and optimize natural resources.
eligibility: Farmers and farmer groups in selected drought-prone and salinity-affected villages of Maharashtra (Marathwada and Vidarbha regions).
documents: 7/12 Extract, 8-A Form, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Caste Certificate (if applicable).
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra

name: Bhausaheb Fundkar Horticulture Plantation Scheme
shortDescription: The scheme aims to utilize the available resources of land and water for horticulture development, thereby increasing the income of farmers.
description: The scheme aims to utilize the available resources of land and water for horticulture development, thereby increasing the income of farmers. It encourages the plantation of fruit crops on fallow land and farm bunds. The pattern of assistance under this scheme covers total amount payable in three years. The subsidy amount is directly credited to the Aadhaar-linked Bank Account every year, subject to plant survival rates.
amount: Full cost of plantation material and maintenance support for 3 years.
benefits: 100% subsidy for fruit orchard plantation (Mango, Pomegranate, Orange, Custard Apple, etc.) provided in three installments (50:30:20) over three years.
eligibility: Individual farmers in Maharashtra having productive land and assured irrigation facilities. Beneficiary must maintain 80% survival in 1st year and 90% in 2nd year.
documents: 7/12 Extract, 8-A Form, Aadhaar Card, Bank Details, Guarantee Bond on stamp paper.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (State)

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA (MGNREGA)
shortDescription: An employment scheme by the Ministry of Rural Development, providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural house...
description: An employment scheme by the Ministry of Rural Development, providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled work. It aims to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by creating durable assets like roads, canals, ponds, and wells.
amount: Daily Wage (variable by state) directly credited to bank/post office account.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per household per financial year. Unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days.
eligibility: Any adult member (above 18 years) of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.
documents: Application for Job Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank/Post Office Account Details, Voter ID/Ration Card.
ministry: Ministry Of Rural Development
